concerns.text: The plan only references the `aligned_data.schema.yaml` contract (step 13) but does not exercise the other contracts defined in the `contracts/` directory (`aligned_timeseries.schema.yaml`, `merged_timeseries.schema.yaml`, `model_result.schema.yaml`, `model_results.schema.yaml`). Every contract should be exercised by at least one plan element to avoid dead‑code contracts.

Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) is claimed to be satisfied, yet the plan does not explicitly designate a single source of truth artifact (e.g., a manifest or canonical data file) that all downstream figures/tables reference. Adding an explicit SSoT designation (e.g., `data/processed/aligned_quarterly.csv` as the authoritative source) would make the claim concrete.
